title: Conjecture B of Keith and Zanello on the parity of eta-powers is false
description:
This is AI-generated research: the results, proofs and code were found and written by AI. Credit goes to all the humans whose work it builds on.

Keith and Zanello conjectured that for every prime p there are infinitely many odd t such that, for some base r, the coefficients of the t-th power of the product of 1 - q^n over all positive n are even on the p - 1 progressions p^2 n + kp + r with k from 1 to p - 1. We show that at p = 73 exactly twenty odd t have this property, the largest being t = 203, so the conjecture is false.

Proved in Lean 4 with Mathlib, with only the standard axioms: the falsity of Conjecture B and the result at p = 73 (Theorem 1 of the paper; KeithZanello.conjectureB_false, checked by Comparator). By computation: Theorems 2 and 3 of the paper (p = 97, and the thirty primes p ≡ 1 (mod 24) below 2000), by certificates that the repository reruns, partly redone by a second program.

Files: the paper, the complete output of every check rerun for the release, and the repository at the release tag. Repository: https://github.com/mt0-svg/keith-zanello-73
